answer: Weight each seat by coin-age, stake times the unbroken span it has sat untouched, and consume that age when you vote, resetting it to zero. Age is conserved and cannot be parallelized: split one treasury across a raven-flock of mirror aliases and each clone accrues only its sliver, so no two can be senior at once. Like saffron, the signal costs because it must be harvested slowly; a farm can copy a wallet shape but never fast-forward the patient months of idle, held stake that real seniority demands.
